prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Spectrum 1-9: page #FBFAF9, text #2D2D1F, accent #42861D, secondary surface #E7EEEF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Inter; narrow display hierarchy with neutral body text. Composition: Full-width relevant image with heading overlay, visible next section, no text/media split hero. Use body 16px, heading 28px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 16px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
